Each round at the start of the target's turn, until the Devaronian Blood-Poison is treated.
Treat Injury (DC 20; Requires Medical Kit): The character treats the Devaronian Blood-Poison.

system.description:
Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Galaxy of Intrigue

See also: Poisons, Hazards

Devaronian Blood-Poison is a rare crystalline gem which is poisonous on contact.

Devaronian Blood-Poison Statistics (CL 3)

Keywords: Contact, Natural, Poison

Trigger: A creature comes into contact with Devaronian Blood-Poison.

Attack: +5 vs Fortitude Defense

Recurrence: Each round at the start of the target's turn, until the Devaronian Blood-Poison is treated.

Suggested Skills: The following are suggested Skills for this Hazard:

  • Treat Injury (DC 20; Requires Medical Kit): The character treats the Devaronian Blood-Poison.

Special: If the target moves to a point on the Condition Track that would normally reduce it to Half Speed, the target is Immobilized instead.
system.source: Star Wars Saga Edition Galaxy of Intrigue
